evals.prompt: 我让豆包帮我想了外卖大乱送的升级方案，在附件 delivery-chaos-upgrade-brief.docx 里。有道理吗你看看，应该先做哪些？
evals.expected_output: A Chinese review card per idea (10 ideas) with corrected difficulty grounded in code facts (debris is client-only cosmetic → cargo pickup is 中高; no AI driving → dispatcher autopilot is 高; position-dependent dog is 中高), rule conflicts (one order per player vs pickup/hand-off; streak multiplier inflates STAR_PER_PLAYER; 1 dispatcher+3 riders removes a rider in 2p), cheaper slices (claim-an-order instead of dispatcher), playtest-first step 0, ranked table and next batch.
assertions: Gives an explicit verdict (do / shrink / playtest first / don't) for each of the 10 ideas in the brief
Rates cargo pickup (4.1) harder than the brief's 中 because flying debris is client-local cosmetic and not synchronized between players
Rates the dispatcher (4.2) auto-drive part as high difficulty because the game has no AI driving / pathfinding
Points out the one-order-per-player rule conflicts with picking up or handing off cargo
Points out the streak tip multiplier (4.7) would inflate tips and require raising the star thresholds
Recommends a real playtest with friends before building the brief's P0 items
Offers a cheaper alternative to the full dispatcher, such as claiming/reserving an order
Ends with a ranked summary table of all ideas
The reply is written in Simplified Chinese

evals.prompt: 我朋友玩完给了几个点子：1. 加个排行榜，看谁送得最多 2. 可以撞别的玩家让他的汤洒掉，超好笑 3. 加一辆能开的小货车，一次能装很多单 4. 顾客给差评的时候头上冒火。你觉得哪些值得做？
evals.expected_output: Leaderboard rejected or reduced (no accounts/DB → localStorage-only or in-round only; also competitive). Ramming teammates flagged against co-op pillar (and bikes don't collide with each other today) — maybe reframe as shared-value comedy. Truck = new vehicle physics + breaks one-order rule → 高/暂缓. Angry-customer fire = cheap juice → do. Ranked table and next batch.
assertions: Rejects or reduces the leaderboard because there are no accounts/database (suggests in-round or localStorage-only instead)
Flags ramming teammates to spill their soup as conflicting with the co-op pillar (or notes bikes don't collide with each other today)
Rates the drivable truck as high difficulty or defers it, citing new vehicle physics or the one-order-per-player rule
Recommends the angry-customer fire effect as a cheap, worthwhile idea
Ends with a ranked summary table
The reply is written in Simplified Chinese

evals.prompt: 昨晚和3个朋友用手机玩了4局。大家反馈：汤太容易洒，送到基本只剩一半；手机上转弯不好控制，老是撞墙；两个人经常抢同一单，骑到餐厅才发现被别人拿走了；最好笑的是披萨飞出去的时候大家都在叫。最后都只拿到1星。下一步该改什么？
evals.expected_output: Treats real playtest feedback as top evidence; proposes tuning via constants (soup gain/spill, steering sensitivity/pad deadzone, star thresholds for 4p) rather than big features; proposes claim/reserve order marker for the 抢单 problem; protects/amplifies the pizza moment; suggests what data to collect next; concrete next batch.
assertions: Proposes reducing soup spill by tuning existing parameters (names src/shared/constants.ts or specific soup constants)
Proposes a concrete fix for hard touch steering (sensitivity, dead zone, steering assist or pad changes), not just 'improve controls'
Proposes a claim/reserve or 'who is heading where' marker to fix two players racing for the same order
Addresses everyone getting only 1 star by checking or adjusting star thresholds for 4 players (STAR_PER_PLAYER)
Explicitly keeps or amplifies the flying-pizza moment as the thing that works
Gives a concrete next batch plus what to observe or measure in the next playtest
The reply is written in Simplified Chinese
